title: GitHub - AtotheY/moosik: Open-source YouTube Music desktop player for Apple Silicon Mac and Windows x64, with searchable listening history and an editable queue. Built on Refryt.
excerpt: Open-source YouTube Music desktop player for Apple Silicon Mac and Windows x64, with searchable listening history and an editable queue. Built on Refryt. - AtotheY/moosik
content_html:
Moosik

A YouTube Music desktop player for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with an editable queue and local listening stats.

Download for Apple Silicon Mac · Windows x64 and all downloads

Install · Listening stats · Queue · Contribute · Report a bug

Early release. Windows x64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 are experimental. Interactive sign-in and playback still need testing on real hardware.

Screenshots

macOS screenshots with signed-out browsing and synthetic listening stats. Click an image to open it at full size. Screenshot details.

Player

  • Browse Home, Explore, albums, artists, search, and your YouTube Music library.
  • Use keyboard shortcuts, synced lyrics, and the fullscreen player.
  • Select and drag several songs in the queue, remove upcoming tracks, and undo edits.
  • Edit YouTube playlists or save songs and local files in private playlists on your computer. Save the current queue with Queue → Save as private playlist.
  • Pin favorite playlists or drag them into nested folders. Shuffle folder mixes songs from every playlist and subfolder into one queue, skipping duplicates.
  • Choose themes, resize sidebars, and adjust transparency. On macOS, pick from ten Eclipse app icons.
  • Show your song with Discord Rich Presence and invite friends to listen along.

Listening history

Moosik records playback from this installation in a local SQLite database. Search past listens by title or artist, filter by date, and see listening time by song, artist, album, or your own genre tags. Stats include skips, completed listens, streaks, and listening patterns. Paused and buffering time are excluded.

Add personal ratings and mood tags. Pick a date range and share your recap as an image or copy links to your top songs. Export song stats as CSV, listening history as JSON, a database backup, or a recap as Markdown. These records, labels, and ratings stay on your computer unless you share them.

Listening history guide · Stat definitions and limitations

Install

Download a package from the latest release or moosik.dev.

Platform Package and status
macOS, Apple Silicon DMG installer and signed in-app updates. See the release for macOS requirements.
Windows, x64 Experimental setup EXE and portable ZIP.
Ubuntu 24.04, x86-64 Experimental Debian package with a clean-install launch check.

On macOS, open the DMG and drag Moosik to Applications. First launch may require approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security. See in-app updates for signing and update details.

Use Moosik with a YouTube Premium or YouTube Music Premium account. The download feature checks for Premium; content availability depends on YouTube and your account.

Build from source

Install Rust 1.90 or newer and the platform dependencies in the build guide. Playback uses libmpv; yt-dlp provides fallback resolution and other media features.

git clone https://github.com/AtotheY/moosik.git
cd moosik
cargo run --locked --release -p moosik --bin moosik

Account and playlists

Choose Sign in, then Use my [browser] login to use an existing YouTube Music session. If you need to sign in again, open that browser from Moosik, sign in to YouTube Music, and choose the same login again. Open sign-in window works independently of browser import, including in Flatpak and on Windows with protected Chrome or Edge profiles. On macOS, Moosik stores the saved YouTube session in Keychain. Windows and Linux use session files.

YouTube playlist edits sync to your account and follow each playlist's visibility settings. Choose Save privately to keep a playlist on this computer.

Keep session files, cookies, and raw account diagnostics private. Review logs and exports before sharing them in an issue.

Contribute

Report a bug, suggest a feature, or help test a platform. Read CONTRIBUTING.md before starting a larger change. Planned work is in the roadmap.

Credits and license

  • gridoe and the original contributors: playback, API integration, and the original desktop interface.
  • Sonora and ytmusic-rs: direct stream URL resolution.
  • yt-dlp: fallback resolution.
  • youtui: ytmapi-rs and the rusty_ytdl fork used by the optional native resolver.
  • ytmdesktop: queue continuation.
  • Spotify's desktop app: shortcuts, selection behavior, and album, playlist, and artist page layouts.
  • LRCLIB: synced lyrics.
  • Theme palettes: Catppuccin, Nord, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Rosé Pine, Everforest, Solarized and Spotify's own colours. Each file in crates/moosik/themes names its source.

Maintained by AtotheY. Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later, including this fork's changes. Existing copyright notices and dependency licenses apply.

Moosik is an unofficial client. YouTube and YouTube Music are trademarks of Google LLC. It uses undocumented YouTube interfaces, so service changes can affect browsing and playback. Use is subject to the applicable service terms.
